title: Characterization of Polynomial-Time RP
statement: For every language $L$ of bit strings, $L$ belongs to the polynomial-time RP class exactly when there is a polynomial-time verifier using polynomially many uniformly random bits that accepts members with probability at least $2/3$ and rejects nonmembers on every random string.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
